prompt: A quadrilateral has exactly ONE pair of parallel sides. What is the shape called?
hint: The word "exactly one" is doing a lot of work here — some shapes have two pairs.

hints.text: The word "exactly one" is doing a lot of work here — some shapes have two pairs.
Parallelograms, rhombuses, and rectangles all have TWO pairs of parallel sides.
With exactly one pair, the shape is a trapezoid.

explanation: Parallelograms, rhombuses, and rectangles all require two pairs of parallel sides, so none of them can have exactly one.
A trapezoid is the quadrilateral defined by having a pair of parallel sides while the other two sides are not parallel.
So the shape is a trapezoid.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture a lampshade
steps: A lampshade outline has a short flat top and a longer flat bottom that are parallel.
Its slanted sides lean toward each other, so they are not parallel — a trapezoid.
